rootCauseOneLine: Subscription-mode voice transcription posts to the ChatGPT web app's Cloudflare-bot-protected endpoint https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/transcribe (not a Codex endpoint); when Cloudflare returns a managed challenge (403 + cf-mitigated: challenge) the daemon retries once with cookies, then throws non-transient codex_request_failed carrying the challenge HTML, so the server neither retries nor falls back and the user sees "HTTP 502: Codex transcription request failed with HTTP 403: <html>...".
proposedFix: Daemon: in transcribeCodexVoice/createCodexHttpError, when the response is still a Cloudflare challenge after the cookie retry, throw codex_service_unavailable (or a new codex_cloudflare_challenge code added to the server's isTransientInferenceError, with a HOST_DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION bump) with a clean message, and never append text/html bodies to error messages. Server: make the transcription fallback meaningful — if OPENAI_API_KEY is configured, fall back to the openai/<model> path (api.openai.com) after a transient/challenge failure instead of fallbackModel === primary model; otherwise keep one delayed retry; map the final challenge failure to buildTranscriptionUnavailableError() (503) and document that BB_TRANSCRIPTION=openai/... + OPENAI_API_KEY avoids chatgpt.com. Optionally persist Cloudflare cookies across daemon restarts. Key any transient classification on cf-mitigated: challenge only, not on all 403s.
caveats: Could not trigger a real Cloudflare challenge from this network with the daemon's full header set (0/18: 8 real daemon calls + 10 curl); the same request with only Authorization was challenged 7/10 and unauthenticated 10/10, so the end-to-end CLI failure was reproduced by injecting the real captured challenge response into the daemon via a Node --import fetch preload (deterministic simulation), plus a unit test that fails on main. Why the reporters' networks are challenged even with the headers is inferred (Cloudflare bot score per IP/fingerprint), not observed. The API-key path was verified by code only (no OpenAI API key available).
